parts.name: Ready-Made Machine Guarding Mounting Hardware - 1/4-20 x 2.00" Carriage Bolt & Hex Nut
parts.description: 1/4-20 x 2.00" carriage bolt and hex nut, one of the three mounting hardware options for the Ready-Made Machine Guarding system. It is shown as the "Thru Bolt & Nut" fastening method for mounting mesh panels to the mounting posts.
parts.notes: The Mounting Hardware table on 2-8 lists Qty 1. On 2-9 (What Do I Need to Order?), the example guard uses 24221 qty 9 with three 24884 Thru Hole 1.50" posts and two 243482 34" x 82" framed mesh panels (3 mounting holes per side).

parts.name: Ready-Made Machine Guarding Mounting Hardware - 1/4-20 x .500” Flanged Bolt x T-Nut w/ Ball Spring
parts.description: 1/4-20 x .500” flanged bolt with T-nut and ball spring, one of the three mounting hardware options for the Ready-Made Machine Guarding system. It is shown as the "Bolt & T-Nut" fastening method for mounting mesh panels to the mounting posts.
parts.notes: The Mounting Hardware table on 2-8 lists Qty 1. On 2-10 it is the Mount to Ready-Made Guarding Suggested Hardware for the 24900 Guarding Post with Control Panel (qty 3), described there as "1/4-20 x .5” Silver FHHB with Self-Aligning Slide-in T-Nut".
